final: WITH type_counts AS (SELECT o.ordertune, COUNT(DISTINCT o.orderspivot) AS order_count FROM orders AS o JOIN riskandmargin AS r ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.ordertune), overall AS (SELECT AVG(order_count) AS average_count FROM type_counts) SELECT AVG(t.order_count) AS average_count_above_average, AVG(t.order_count - a.average_count) AS average_excess FROM type_counts AS t CROSS JOIN overall AS a WHERE t.order_count > a.average_count
